novel_features.name: Prompt history FTS
novel_features.description: Full-text search every prompt you have ever sent to Magnific, filtered by model, date, or cost — your generation archive becomes queryable instead of lost in a tab.

novel_features.name: Model bake-off
novel_features.description: Fire the same prompt at N image or video models in parallel, then return a manifest of cost, latency, and output URL per model so you can pick the right tool empirically.

novel_features.name: Unified task wait/watch
novel_features.description: Resolve any Magnific task_id back to its model endpoint and block (or stream) until terminal state — one command across all 80+ async model families.

novel_features.name: Cost ledger + forecast
novel_features.description: Local SQL aggregation over every task you have run: spend by model, by day, by tag, with a sibling `cost forecast` that estimates a planned batch against the curated per-model credit cost table.

novel_features.name: Local asset gallery
novel_features.description: Filter every output you have ever downloaded by tag, date, orientation, or model. Companion `gallery open <id>` reveals the file (opt-in side effect under --launch).

novel_features.name: Models registry with empirical stats
novel_features.description: Curated catalog of every Magnific model (family, listed credit cost, capabilities) joined with your local task aggregation (your run count + credits spent per model). Sibling `models stats <model>` reports run / completed / failed counts and success rate.

novel_features.name: Stale-task reconcile
novel_features.description: Find tasks the local store thinks are still pending past a threshold; sibling `tasks reconcile` re-polls each via the real GET and updates terminal state.

novel_features.name: Prompt templates / replay
novel_features.description: Save reusable prompt templates with {{placeholder}} syntax; replay them with --override key=value substitutions through the real Magnific endpoint.

novel_features.name: Stock library local index
novel_features.description: Walk your downloaded Freepik icons/videos/resources into a local FTS5 index. `stock library search` queries that index first before hitting the API.

novel_features.name: Agent context bundle
novel_features.description: Single command emitting JSON with: top 10 most-used models, last 10 prompts, recent output directories, and the live API reachability status. Read-only and MCP-safe.
